Fig. 1. Overview of the Stage 1 tri-axial ROI extraction pipeline. A 2D nnU-Net processes slices sampled from three orthogonal axes; bounding box coordinates are extracted from each 2D prediction and averaged across axes to obtain the final 3D ROI.
Fig. 5. (a) Plugin interface within 3D Slicer. (b) Segmentation and classification results on an MRA scan.
Fig. 2. Stage 2 multi-task framework. Dual segmentation decoders produce vessel and aneurysm location masks; three classification heads predict modality, aneurysm presence, and location.
